steps.content: With your unveiling of the truth, Fortuna's final layer of disguise is lifted. A wave of Mania energy is unleashed, pinning you to your seat.
The Mania energy distorts the appearances of the actors—phantoms of those who once visited Fortuna, and their performances are also becoming nonsensical.

steps.speaker: Crazed Actor
steps.content: The investor... as long as we have her as an investor... there will be no lack of money...

steps.speaker: Crazed Actor
steps.content: The beauty of Fortuna will live on... for all eternity...

options: Is this the truth about Fortuna?

choices.text: Is this the truth about Fortuna?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You invested in the theater. You lure those obsessed with what-ifs into this place and cast them as actors in this production or that, wiping their existence from the real world.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And you watch them make choices and struggle as a bystander, taking pleasure in their gradual downfall.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Here, in this world of make-believe, they see the versions of themselves they want to see, live out the versions of their lives they wish to live out, until their small but bright fires of desire die out...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Their sincerity, their struggle, their passion... To me, that's the true value of Fortuna!
You look up at Lady Pearl. Your burst of anger doesn't seem to have dampened her enthusiasm in the slightest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Investor</color> Lady Pearl, what role exactly do you play in this story?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: A helper, a spectator, someone who provides them with choices.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Unfortunately, their choices are not guiding them toward a happy ending, it seems to me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You could have kept this from me. Why did tell me?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Perhaps it's because... I'm looking forward to the protagonist's awe-inspiring entrance.
Lady Pearl dabs your cheek with her finger.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Why do you look so worked up, my dear?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: You wanted to be just a spectator, and you've got your wish. Now you're not happy with the direction the show is taking?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The bottom line is a spectator is just an outsider. You're in no position to change how a story goes, unless...
You pick up on what she is implying.

options: It's time for me to get involved again.
I have no choice but to get involved now.

choices.text: It's time for me to get involved again.
I have no choice but to get involved now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Unless I become an actor too... It's time for me to get involved again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Unless I become an actor too... I have no choice but to get involved now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ah, I wanted to keep this low-key...
Lady Pearl gives a satisfied smile and places her hand on the back of yours.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: The other characters have all made their choices...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Don't you think the <color=#fb9259>protagonist</color> should step out of the sidelines at some point and get in on the action?
The shackles pierce the illusory realm, and the theater grows more unsteady. You've decided to go on stage.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's skip the dramatic lines this time and get this over with.
A silver longsword materializes in your hand. A familiar pain radiates from your wrist, but this time the strings will not hold you back.
The actors turn their heads in unison to look at you. They have finally noticed your presence. Moments later, they rush toward you as if possessed.

steps.speaker: Crazed Actor
steps.content: Hahaha... it's the investor! The investor is here!

steps.speaker: Crazed Actor
steps.content: Please help us! Please...
You swing the sword, breaking the shackles and slashing the curtain. Slits appear on the walls of the illusory realm.

The few actors before you collapse, but more emerge out of the slits. Some of them look familiar. It dawns on you that you saw them in the theater on that fateful night—these are the individuals who willingly entered Lady Pearl's world of illusions.
More and more actors are entering the fray. They're becoming too numerous to handle. Meanwhile, Lady Pearl simply stands there watching the fight.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: If you're not happy with the status quo, change it.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: My dear ${PlayerName}...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Even if it's a show, even if it might be in vain, the effort will surely be enough to...
All too soon, you are overwhelmed by the actors. Then you fall into the limbo between reality and fantasy.
<size=45>— Act Two: Present —</size>
A gloomy man in a quiet corner... He looks left and right to make sure there's no one around before answering the phone.

steps.speaker: Male Prop Master
steps.content: How many times do I have to tell you? There was nothing wrong with the equipment. I checked it!

steps.speaker: Male Prop Master
steps.content: Then how come you're the only one who fell? Wasn't it because your skills were below par?
Whimpering can be heard from the other end of the line, which only serves to further irritate the man.

steps.speaker: Male Prop Master
steps.content: You listen carefully. There's no way in hell you're gonna get any money out of me!
The man hangs up, fuming. He takes a few calming breaths and dials another number.

steps.speaker: Male Prop Master
steps.content: Hello, is this <color=#fb9259>Lady Pearl</color>? Yes, someone sabotaged our equipment and is trying to scam money from us. Something has to be done about this, or there might be trouble down the line.

steps.speaker: Male Prop Master
steps.content: I was wondering if you could help.
A young woman picking through a pile of luxurious dresses... She decides on a bejeweled long dress and throws it into a packed shopping basket.
Fine clothes, jewelry, accessories... She has visited every shop in the department store, and now she is standing at the checkout with her spoils.

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: Wrap these up, and these, too. Have them delivered to the theater. As for the bill...

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: As usual, add it to <color=#fb9259>Lady Pearl's</color> account.

steps.speaker: Young Actress
steps.content: Of all the troupe members, she admires me the most. This amount of money means nothing to her. Of course she'll be willing to foot the bill for me.
The show has begun, and all the other troupe members are on stage. A man is all alone in the box office tallying the day's earnings.
After counting the money, he puts it in the cash box. He starts doing the books. Right before he records the amount in the ledger, however, he catches himself.
Night has fallen. In the quiet, he doctors the figures slightly, before reaching his hand into the cash box...
You continue to fall in the limbo. Every once in a while, a memory swims up to meet you and reveals itself to you.
The investor's wealth knows no bounds, and she gives freely, never asking probing questions. The money she gives feeds the desires of the receivers, as well as their all-consuming fantasies.
With the great investor as your "safety net," you can do whatever you want here.
You try to resist, but it's no use. You fall into another memory.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: Cough, cough...
A drunken man collapsing in an alley... He curses the game of poker he just lost while struggling to stand up.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: Dammit, can't believe I let that ****** trick me into going all in... Turned out he wasn't bluffing...

He fumbles in his many pockets for taxi fares, but all of them are empty. He keeps searching, as if convinced his persistence will be rewarded. Then his stomach lurches, and he almost throws up right there on the street.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: **** me! Well, no big deal. I'll give her a call. And money will come. Blegh, blegh...
Who is he going to call?

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: Ah, <color=#fb9259>Lady Pearl</color>, you're here!

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: The troupe? Oh, Fortuna is doing great. We all have you to thank for that.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: I... Well, I... I don't how to say this...
The man hems and haws. And then he falls to his knees in front of Lady Pearl, shedding crocodile tears.

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: Please, please help me this one last time!

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: All I need is one more chance. I'm gonna win it all back! And everything is gonna be all right... Fortuna is gonna be all right! I'm sure of it.
Lady Pearl looks down at the rambling drunk. It's a while before she opens her mouth.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: ...I'm more than happy to help you.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: But this time... I need you to think it through before accepting my help.

You're now seeing through the man's eyes, as if you were inhabiting his body. Lady Pearl bends forward slightly, and in a gesture reminiscent of one giving changes to a beggar, hands you an unsigned transfer agreement regarding the ownership of Fortuna.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Are you absolutely sure you want my help?

steps.speaker: Impresario
steps.content: Haha... Haha...
You reach out your hand. You eagerly grab the paper and sign your full name on it.
Unfortunately, your hand disobeys you. It eagerly grabs the agreement, and signs your full name on it.
The deal has been made. Lady Pearl watches as the impresario rises to his feet, clutching a thick stack of cash, and stumbles back into the casino.
You see it this time, as clear as day: red light, a manifestation of Mania energy, issuing from her hands.
You're back to reality. You realize with a start that you're standing in the center of the Fortuna Theater stage. What you just experienced was nothing more than an elaborate illusion.
Phantoms are floating in front of you. Beyond them, you see a lone figure sitting in the dimness. It's none other than Lady Pearl.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: No, they chose the path of self-destruction of their own volition.
You and Lady Pearl lock eyes. She seems to be wearing a dreamy smile, as if reminiscing about some bygone days.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Fortuna was a wonderful place in its early days. One simple tent and some old costumes... But the actors were committed to their craft, and their performances were full of life.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: They were acting, yes, but their passion couldn't have been more genuine.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: It was a place full of laughter and joy. Everyone was happy. No one cared about family backgrounds.
Lady Pearl tilts the brim of her hat upwards slightly, rises to her feet, and approaches the stage.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Intense emotions and strong desires can give birth to Mania energy. So what?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I loved that Fortuna. That's why I helped keep it afloat.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: It's not Fortuna that changed, but the people in it. They became the sort of person I despise—the most boring sort that I had had business dealings with.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Their acting skills were beyond reproach, but their performances were soulless.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: No one wants to invest in a meaningless business. I'm no exception.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: So, I decided to restore it to the way it had once been.
Lady Pearl walks into the light. And you see her face clearly. It's then that you realize she's trapped in the theater, just like all the actors you've seen here.

"A magnificent dance, erasing every hardship!"

"Join the dance, let joy mend every wound."

"Time marches on, but the dance goes ever on, grand and timeless."
No one is more trapped than the manager of the theater herself.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: This is Fortuna! A place where spectacular dramas are presented, and colorful lives are showcased!

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: We've agreed to seal our deal with a perfect performance...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I hope you're not going back on your word.

The dancer which is the manifestation of the Choice of Destiny rises above the auditorium behind Lady Pearl. The dancer's presence means the show is coming to an end, and any actor lost in the show will soon be consumed.
This time around, however, there will be only two actors.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Give me two hours of your time. Watch a show with me, my last. I wrote the script. It's an unfinished script, but bear witness to it with me. Let's refine it together, find a perfect ending for it...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I want to feel that surge of passion again... This is my condition.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Let's continue, shall we? This will be the last act...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: It's time to make the final choice.
